title: Install and use the store plugin

steps.task: Add the tauri-plugin-store crate to the Rust backend's dependencies in `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`.
Register the store plugin with the app builder in `lib.rs`. The scaffold's `greet` command must keep working.

mutations.diff:
--- a/src-tauri/src/lib.rs
+++ b/src-tauri/src/lib.rs
@@ -8,6 +8,7 @@
 pub fn run() {
     tauri::Builder::default()
         .plugin(tauri_plugin_opener::init())
+        .plugin(tauri_plugin_store::Builder::default().build())
         .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![greet])
         .run(tauri::generate_context!())
         .expect("error while running tauri application");

steps.task: Install the JavaScript guest bindings package with the project's package manager.
From the frontend, load a store called `store.json`, set a key, read it back and save the store. The TypeScript build must stay green.
Use the store from Rust in the app's setup hook: load `store.json`, set a key, read it back and release the resource.
Let the frontend use the store: loading a store from the webview must be denied before the capability grants the store permissions and succeed after.
